scan_root.description: Top-level directory to scan for age/usage analysis

index_file.description: Path to the index data file

listen_address.description: Network address for the web server to bind to. Defaults to ANY to pick an arbitrary port, or a specific address like 127.0.0.1.

port.description: Port number for the web server; 0 selects an arbitrary unused port if listen_address is specified without port, or port in addr[:port].

auth_mode.description: Authentication mode for the web server: 'magic', 'basic', 'none', or 'default'. Default attempts magic then falls back to basic with a generated password.

cross_fs.description: Whether to cross filesystem boundaries during scan (default: false)

dir_atime.description: Whether to fake atime for directories based on contents (default: true)

mtime.description: Use modification time instead of access time (default: false)

progress.description: Enable progress reporting during scan (default: true)

prune.description: List of filename wildcards to omit entirely from scan and not recurse into directories matching them

prune_path.description: List of full-pathname wildcards to omit entirely from scan and not recurse into directories matching them

exclude.description: List of filename wildcards to omit from index but still recurse into matching directories

exclude_path.description: List of full-pathname wildcards to omit from index but still recurse into matching directories

include.description: List of filename wildcards to re-include after exclude/prune rules

include_path.description: List of full-pathname wildcards to re-include after exclude/prune rules

age_range.description: Age range for HTML report colour mapping, e.g. '2y-3m' (oldest-newest) or '2y' (oldest only)

files.description: Include individual files in reports (default: false)

depth.description: Maximum recursion depth for text or HTML reports; use 0 for root-only, 'max' for unlimited

output_dir.description: Output directory for recursive HTML reports (required when depth>1 in HTML mode)

numeric_names.description: Use numeric filenames (e.g., 73.html) for recursive HTML output (default: false)

launch.description: Shell command to run with the web server base URL appended (e.g., 'browse')

no_eof.description: Disable termination on EOF from standard input in web server mode (default: false)
